sentences.text:
Smt. Jannabi Joarder @ Janhabi Joarder & ... vs The State Of
West Bengal & Anr on 17 May, 2023

Author: Bibek Chaudhuri
Bench: Bibek Chaudhuri
17.05.2023 Sl. No.16.
D/L. Mithun.
Ct.No.42.
Crr/4070/2022 Smt. Jannabi Joarder @ Janhabi Joarder & Ors.
Vs.
The State of West Bengal & Anr.

Mr. Ayan Bhattacharjee, Adv.
Ms. Arani Bhattacharyya, Adv.
...for the petitioner.

Testamentary disposition of some property by the testator who was the father of the petitioner No.1
and father in law of the opposite party No.2 is the root of all dispute between the parties.

As a result
of such dispute at the instigation of the husband, the opposite party No.2 has filed the complaint
under Sections 498A/354B/376/511/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code against her sister in law,
husband of the sister in law and their two children.
The petitioners are directed to serve notice upon the private opposite party under registered speed post with acknowledgment due and file affidavit of service within two weeks after vacation.
In the meantime, further proceeding in connection with G.R. Case No.1428 of 2021 be stayed till 15th August, 2023.

( Bibek Chaudhuri, J. )
